title: Skill eval round owed: objectstack-data and objectstack-ui cases for related-list tabs and extension place (PR #36527, card #35902)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2`. It carries the eval round that PR #36527 does not measure, so the round has a home when `Fixes #35902` closes the card. This follows l2-review#4 record 7083563112 (accepted deviations). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What is owed

Card #35902's done-when names passing eval cases for the skill text it teaches. PR #36527 teaches:

- the extension `place` paragraph in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`;
- the flipped record-page sentence in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`;
- new eval case 26 in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`.

No model round has read any of them: skill evals were NOT MEASURED on the PR.

## The round

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-data,objectstack-ui` on `main` after #36527 merges. The runner has no per-case filter, so this is every case of both skills × 2 arms. It belongs to the eval seat's schedule, not a lane dev. Keep when case 26 and the record-page cases pass at the with-skill arm and the rest hold at their last kept score.

Re-check: the newest eval-run record for `objectstack-data` names a commit that contains #36527's merge.
